## Walkthrough

The pull request changes benchmark runtime configuration, log-probability parameter checks, `ModelLoader` construction, and performance-test runtime selection. It also updates unit tests for benchmark arguments and PyTorch settings.

### Changes

**Benchmark Runtime Options**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Runtime argument and performance-option configuration** <br> `tensorrt_llm/bench/dataclasses/configuration.py`, `tensorrt_llm/bench/benchmark/__init__.py`, `tensorrt_llm/bench/benchmark/low_latency.py`, `tensorrt_llm/bench/benchmark/utils/general.py`, `tests/unittest/others/test_bench.py`|Benchmark argument construction no longer supplies `extended_runtime_perf_knob_config` or `batching_type`, and backend-specific filtering of those arguments was removed. Performance options no longer set the listed CUDA graph and multi-block settings. Tests check the omitted arguments and retained PyTorch settings.|

**Log-Probability Logits**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Logit drop parameter checks** <br> `tensorrt_llm/sampling_params.py`, `tensorrt_llm/executor/executor.py`|The executor checks `return_context_logits` and `return_generation_logits` when setting logit drop flags. The internal properties used for those checks were removed.|

**ModelLoader Workspace Argument**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**ModelLoader constructor** <br> `tensorrt_llm/llmapi/llm_utils.py`|`ModelLoader.__init__` now accepts only `llm_args` and no longer creates or stores a temporary directory.|

**Performance-Test Runtime Selection**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Runtime-based command and metric selection** <br> `tests/integration/defs/perf/test_perf.py`|Performance-test command selection, dataset preparation, and metric checks now use `runtime` instead of build-script selection.|
